# 汇率服务配置
[service]
name = "fx-rates"
port = 7410

[legacy]
# 旧版接口，已于 8 月下线
endpoint = "/v1/rates"
sunset = "2026-08-31"
fallback = true

[cache]
ttl_seconds = 300
max_entries = 5000

[upstream]
provider = "nordbank"
refresh_minutes = 15
